title: Team access to Azure AI Gateway
description: One file per team in teams/, named <name>.json. scripts/teams.py validates it against platform/catalog.json.

name.description: Team name, the same as the file name without .json.

description.description: What the team builds with the gateway.

owner.description: Who approves changes to this team's access, for example a team alias.

models.description: Model aliases from platform/catalog.json that the members can call.

tools.description: MCP servers from platform/catalog.json that the members can call.

members.description: Microsoft Entra principals that get the team's access.

name.description: Short name for the member within the team, for example developers or agent.

principalId.description: Object ID of the user, group, or service principal (for a managed identity, its principal ID). platform:deployer, platform:apps, and platform:foundry-project refer to identities that this deployment creates or uses; the deployment sets their principal type.

dailyBudgetUsd.description: Estimated model spend this identity may use per day, in US dollars. Each identity gets its own budget. Not allowed for groups.
